Direction 03 · locked 16 Sept 2026

Riso
Pop

Curie's colour system. Two flat fluorescent inks over newsprint, every value derived from six base inks and refused by the build script until all 39 rendered pairs clear WCAG AA. This page is rendered in the system it specifies.

Three laws

imposed by arithmetic, not taste

Fluoro pink is a ground, never text

#FF48A0 is 2.94:1 as text on paper and 2.94:1 under white — both fail. It carries ink at 5.68:1, and that is the only way it is ever used. The amber palette already made this exact call for the same reason.

Pink that must be read is #D6117A

4.65:1. The fluoro stays for fills, chips and grounds. Any pink carrying a sentence is the deep one — and Chemistry's subject ink goes deeper still, to #B00463, because a tinted tile eats half a point of contrast.

Yellow never appears unbounded

#FFD21E is 1.35:1 on newsprint — literally invisible. So it always sits inside a keyline. That is not a workaround: keylines and registration marks are what riso printing looks like, so the constraint and the aesthetic want the same thing.

The six inks

everything else is mixed from these
GROUND ONLY
Fluoro pink#FF48A0The signature. Chips, fills, the raised hand.
PRIMARY
Riso blue#0B5FD9The thing you press. Carries paper at 5.37:1.
KEYLINE ME
Riso yellow#FFD21EHighlight and headers. Never without an edge.
CORRECT
Overprint green#196B46A right answer. 6.07:1 as text on paper.
THE BOARD
Newsprint#FAF7F0The ground everything is drawn on.
EVERY WORD
Ink#17171DBody text at 16.68:1, and every keyline.

The mark

same geometry, overprinted
Primary. Two inks, two orbits — one per plate, the way riso actually prints.
Reversed. The app icon and the splash, where one flat plate is all you get.
curie
Ek class. Ek doubt. Done.
Wordmark, lowercase, Archivo at width 125. The strapline is always keylined — law 3.

Type

chosen for Devanagari, not only for Latin
Display — Archivo, weight 900, width 125
Heart ke do side hain

Why. Riso is a poster medium and posters need a face that can go wide and heavy without turning into a cartoon. Archivo is a variable grotesque with a real width axis, so one file covers the wordmark, the headings and the chips.

Body — Anek Latin, 300–700
She narrates in Hinglish, and the ear expects Hinglish back. “Dekho — left side mein oxygen wala blood aata hai, right side mein carbon dioxide wala.”

Why this one specifically. Anek is a variable superfamily from Ek Type, an Indian foundry, and it ships matching designs for Devanagari and eight other Indic scripts. Today the Hinglish is written in Latin — but the moment a lesson carries a Devanagari term, or you ship a Hindi-script mode, it is the same family at the same optical weight rather than a fallback that jumps. That is a product decision disguised as a font choice.

Data — JetBrains Mono
₹0.22 / class · 3.6 min on task · 39/39 pairs pass

Why. Costs, contrast ratios and outcome ids all line up in columns. Tabular figures, everywhere digits are compared.

What this changes

and what it deliberately does not
  1. Two generated files replace one hand-written one. docs/brand/riso-pop.theme.css → apps/classroom/src/theme.css, and riso-pop.tints.css replaces the subject-tint block in index.css. Both come out of docs/brand/build-theme.mjs, which refuses to emit anything while a single pair is under AA.
  2. No screen changes. All 47 token names and all 12 tint class names are kept, so every component keeps working. The re-skin is a palette swap, not a refactor.
  3. The keyline becomes a real token. --key: 2.5px is new, and it is what makes law 3 enforceable rather than a note in a document.
  4. The logo is redrawn, not recoloured. content/icon.svg and src/ui/Logo.tsx share one 32-unit geometry today; the two orbits split onto two inks, which keeps that arrangement and makes the overprint the idea.
  5. The manifest stops disagreeing. theme_color and background_color go to #FAF7F0, so the install screen, the icon and the app are finally one brand.
  6. Nothing is applied yet. Everything above lives under docs/brand/ and touches no shipping file until you say so.
